name: The Drowned Manifest of the *Cassilda Queen*

rooms.name: Gangway
dressing: Salt wind whines through the rigging above
Black water laps against the hull below
Faded lettering on the hull reads CASSILDA QUEEN

hiddenDressing.text: Deep parallel gouges score the hull just above the waterline, as if something with claws climbed aboard.

rooms.name: Main Deck Hallway
rooms.description: A long corridor runs the length of the deck, its rotted carpet squelching underfoot. Doors line both walls, several hanging open on swollen hinges, and the air tastes of brine and decay.
dressing: Framed photographs of smiling passengers hang crooked and water-stained
A fire axe is missing from its glass case, the glass shattered
Drips fall steadily from a burst pipe in the ceiling

hiddenDressing.text: Wet webbed footprints, far too large for any passenger, lead down the hall and fade at the carpet's driest stretch.

rooms.name: Atrium Lobby
rooms.description: The grand atrium rises three decks around a stairwell choked with seaweed. A chandelier lies crashed in the center of the floor, its crystals scattered like teeth across the moldering carpet.
dressing: The chandelier's crystals crunch underfoot
A grandfather clock stands stopped at 3:07, its face clouded with condensation
Faint, rhythmic dripping echoes from the stairwell above

hiddenDressing.text: Someone has scratched a rough spiral into the elevator doors with a nail, over and over, dozens of times.

rooms.name: Reception Office
rooms.description: A cramped office behind the front desk, papers fused into pulpy bricks on every surface. A small wall safe hangs open and empty, its dial encrusted with green corrosion.
dressing: A ring of keys still hangs on a numbered hook board
Mold blooms in a perfect circle on the ceiling

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: A grand dining saloon of white-clothed tables, the cloths now hanging in gray rotted strips. One table near the center is still set for dinner — and the chairs around it have been knocked back, as though the diners left in a hurry.
dressing: Tarnished silverware lies scattered as if swept from a table
A sour smell of spoiled wine hangs in the air
The windows are completely fogged with algae from the outside

hiddenDressing.text: Every plate on the set table is clean — licked clean, down to the porcelain.

rooms.name: Galley
rooms.description: The ship's galley is a chaos of overturned pots and rusting steel. Something has been living in here — fish bones and cracked crab shells are heaped in the corner in a mound nearly waist-high.
dressing: Copper pans hang from a rack, green with verdigris
The heap of fish bones in the corner clicks and settles occasionally
Rancid oil smell coats the back of the throat

rooms.name: Walk-in Freezer
rooms.description: The freezer door hangs open on a room rimed with old frost now melted to slime. Sides of beef still hang from hooks, gray and mummified, and the back wall is coated in a thick layer of frozen seawater that never drained.
dressing: The air is noticeably colder than the rest of the ship
Ice crystals feather the seams of the walls

hiddenDressing.text: The ice coating the back wall has claw marks frozen inside it, scratching outward from within.

rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.description: Shelves of swollen cans and burst jars line this narrow pantry. Everything edible is long gone — gnawed through, tins peeled open like fruit.
dressing: Tiny clawed footprints track through spilled flour on the floor
A smell of vinegar and rot seeps from burst jars

rooms.name: Ballroom
rooms.description: A velvet-draped ballroom with a low stage and a grand piano, miraculously intact. The dance floor gleams with a thin skin of standing water that reflects the ceiling like a dark mirror — and the reflections move half a heartbeat late.
dressing: Standing water covers the dance floor in a perfect mirror
A single phonograph record still sits on the stage turntable
Faint perfume lingers impossibly under the stench of rot

hiddenDressing.text: Sheet music on the piano stand is handwritten, not printed, and the notation does not correspond to any earthly scale.

rooms.name: Cabin Hallway
rooms.description: A narrow corridor of numbered cabin doors, low ceilinged and claustrophobic. Somewhere behind the walls, water sloshes rhythmically, keeping time with nothing.
dressing: Cabin doors are numbered in tarnished brass: 1 through 12, most shut tight
A room service tray lies overturned, its contents long since eaten down to the garnish
The light fittings hold dead bulbs frosted with salt

hiddenDressing.text: The inside of cabin door 4 is covered in scratch marks at shoulder height.

rooms.name: Cabin A
rooms.description: A first-class cabin, its bed neatly made beneath an inch of silt and one very large, very wet footprint. The porthole is cracked, and thin gray daylight seeps through.
dressing: Gray daylight filters weakly through the cracked porthole
A steamer trunk sits open and empty, its silk lining shredded

rooms.name: Cabin B
rooms.description: This cabin has been stripped bare — mattress, linens, luggage all gone. Scratched into the wall above the bedframe, over and over in different hands, is a single phrase: DON'T LET IT SING.
dressing: The scratched warning covers the wall in dozens of overlapping hands
The air here is dry, strangely, and smells faintly of ozone

rooms.name: Cabin C
rooms.description: A cabin left mid-packing: dresses still laid out on the bed, a half-filled suitcase open on the floor, everything dusted with silt as though the owners simply ceased to be.
dressing: A pair of shoes sits side by side at the foot of the bed
The porthole is sealed shut but weeps rust at its seam

rooms.name: Crew Quarters
rooms.description: Rows of narrow bunks line this cramped crew berth. The blankets are gone, and something has built a low nest of shredded uniforms, rope, and bone in the far corner.
dressing: The nest in the corner is still faintly warm
Pin-up photographs and postcards are pinned inside each bunk, bleached by damp

rooms.name: Bridge
rooms.description: The ship's bridge overlooks a gray, motionless sea. The wheel is lashed hard to starboard, and every gauge has been smashed from the inside. On the chart table, a course has been plotted in grease pencil straight into open ocean — then scribbled over and over until the paper tore.
dressing: The wheel is lashed with rope tied in strange, elaborate knots
Salt crusts every window in fern-like patterns
The compass spins slowly and never settles

hiddenDressing.text: The last logbook page is not written — it is bitten, torn out by teeth, and the stub remains in the binding.

rooms.name: Engine Room
rooms.description: The vast engine room descends into darkness around the ship's dead engines. Black water stands knee-deep on the lower level, and something moves through it in slow circles, never quite surfacing.
dressing: Black water laps at the lower catwalk in slow circles
Oil rainbows swirl on the water's surface
A wrench hangs from a valve on a chain, swaying gently

rooms.name: Cargo Hold
rooms.description: The hold yawns vast and echoing, stacked with cargo that never reached its port. In the center, crates have been torn open and rearranged into a rough circle around a brackish pool that should not exist this far above the waterline — and the pool is breathing.
dressing: The central pool rises and falls in a slow breathing rhythm
Salt-crusted shipping manifests are tacked to a clipboard by the door
Every torn crate is stamped with the same port of origin: a name no map records

hiddenDressing.text: The breathing pool has no source and no drain — the steel floor beneath it is whole.

rooms.name: Promenade Deck
rooms.description: The open promenade runs along the ship's flank under a weeping gray sky. Deck chairs lie in a tangled drift against the rail, and the sea beyond is utterly, wrongfully still.
dressing: The sea is flat as glass in every direction, no shore in sight
Gulls circle high above but never cry out
The rail is bowed outward in one place, as if gripped by something enormous

hiddenDressing.text: Beneath the drift of chairs, a shuffleboard court is scored with fresh deep grooves that cross the painted lines.

rooms.name: Lifeboat Deck
rooms.description: The lifeboat station stands at the ship's stern. Most davits hang empty, their boats long gone, but one lifeboat remains — swung out, lowered partway, and waiting, as though someone prepared an escape that never happened.
dressing: Empty davit ropes sway and creak in the wind
A flare gun lies on the deck, corroded into uselessness
The one remaining lifeboat's ropes are old but sound

entities.name: Passenger Strongbox (60 gp in soggy banded notes and coins)

statBlock.name: Drowned Crewman
statBlock.appearance: a bloated corpse in a rotted white steward's jacket, skin gray-green and waterlogged, eyes clouded white, seawater dribbling from its mouth

statBlock.name: Bilge Slime
statBlock.appearance: a glistening mound of translucent gray-green sludge shot through with flecks of black, slowly rippling, with half-dissolved fish bones suspended inside it

entities.name: The swollen freezer door slams shut and its rusted latch engages when the room is fully entered (DC 14 Athletics to force)

statBlock.name: Drowned Socialite
statBlock.appearance: a bloated corpse in the shreds of a sequined evening gown, gray-green skin split at the cheeks, pearls fused to its swollen neck, hair hanging in wet ropes

statBlock.name: Deep Spawn
statBlock.appearance: a hunched humanoid with rubbery gray-green skin, huge unblinking fish eyes, a wide lipless mouth, and webbed clawed hands, draped in a tattered crew uniform

statBlock.name: Deep Spawn
statBlock.appearance: a squat humanoid with mottled slate-colored skin, bulging glassy eyes, needle teeth in a too-wide mouth, and finned ridges along its forearms

entities.name: Crewman's Lockbox (15 gp and a vial of holy water)

statBlock.name: Herald of the Drowned Tide
statBlock.appearance: a towering amphibious horror with mottled gray-green flesh, a crest of quivering fins, bulging luminous eyes, and a torso split by a second mouth ringed with tendrils; barnacles crust its shoulders and seawater streams constantly from its bulk

entities.name: The Drowned Manifest (the ship's true cargo ledger)
Crate of Curios (120 gp in strange idols and jewelry)

goals: Recover the Drowned Manifest from the Cargo Hold
Find the ship's logbook on the Bridge
